{{Short description|American mathematician}}
'''Edward F. Aboufadel''' is an American mathematician<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=aqxWvBMAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao |title=Edward Aboufadel |access-date=December 27, 2017}}</ref> currently Professor at [[Grand Valley State University]] and an Elected Fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.hollandsentinel.com/news/20171203/gvsu-prof-named-science-fellow |title=GVSU Professor Named Science Fellow |date=December 3, 2017 |publisher=hollandsentinel.com |access-date=December 27, 2017}}</ref>

==Education==
He earned his B.S at [[Michigan State University]] in 1986 and his PhD at [[Rutgers University]] in 1992<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://faculty.gvsu.edu/aboufade/ |title=Edward F. Aboufadel |publisher=gvsu.edu |access-date=December 27, 2017}}</ref> under the supervision of [[Jane Cronin Scanlon]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=6228}}</ref>

==Research==
His interests are [[Wavelet|wavelets]] and data sets and 3D printing.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.gvsu.edu/math/module-directory-view.htm?siteModuleId=E42599CC-9353-104B-9CD1D8BE26E9BC60&entryId=E425B2B6-D42C-F4E2-9BE5183249507860 |title=Edward Aboufadel |publisher=gvsu.edu |access-date=December 27, 2017 |archive-date=December 28, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171228054445/https://www.gvsu.edu/math/module-directory-view.htm?siteModuleId=E42599CC-9353-104B-9CD1D8BE26E9BC60&entryId=E425B2B6-D42C-F4E2-9BE5183249507860 |url-status=dead }}</ref> His highest cited paper is "Discovering wavelets".<ref>E Aboufadel, S Schlicker. Discovering wavelets. 2011. John Wiley & Sons.</ref>

==Publications==
*Edward Aboufadel, David Austin. A new method for computing the mean center of population of the United States. 58:1. 65–69. The Professional Geographer. 2006.
*Merle C Potter, Jack Leonard Goldberg, Edward Aboufadel. Advanced engineering mathematics. Oxford University Press. 2005.
*C Beckmann, P Wells, J Gabrosek, E Billings, E Aboufadel, P Curtiss, W Dickson, D Austin, A Champion. Enhancing the mathematical understanding of prospective teachers: Using Standards-based, grades K–12 activities. 151–163. Perspectives on the teaching of mathematics. 2004.
